agent_development_kit_adk_and_skills.title: Agent Development Kit (ADK 2.0) & Official ADK Skills
agent_development_kit_adk_and_skills.description: Complete guide to Google's Agent Development Kit (ADK 2.0) on Vertex AI: LlmAgent, workflow orchestrators, where to find and install official ADK coding skills (google-agents-cli, adk.dev/llms.txt), and runtime SkillToolset.

agent_platform_models.title: Agent Platform Latest Models Catalog (Single Model Per Tier)

antigravity_2_paygo_and_ide_setup.title: Antigravity 2.0 Pay-As-You-Go (PayGo) & IDE Setup

bigquery_ai_and_analytics.title: Google BigQuery: Serverless Analytics, In-SQL Gemini & Vector Search

cloud_run_serverless_and_gpus.title: Google Cloud Run: Serverless Containers, Agents & GPUs

datastores_cloudsql_alloydb_spanner_fire.title: Operational Data Stores: Spanner Graph, AlloyDB, Cloud SQL, Firestore & GCS

gcp_cli_and_project_setup.title: Google Cloud CLI & Project Access Setup

gcp_mcp_servers_catalog.title: Google Cloud Native Integrated & Local MCP Servers

gemini_embedding_2_multimodal.title: Gemini Embedding 2 (Multimodal Embeddings)

graphrag_architectures_on_gcp.title: How to Build GraphRAGs on Google Cloud

multimodal_live_voice_and_media.title: Multimodal Live API, Voice (TTS/ASR), Image & Video Generation

protocols_mcp_and_a2a.title: Agentic Protocols: MCP & A2A

rag_grounding_and_search.title: RAG, Grounding & Search on Google Cloud

security_finops_and_quotas.title: Security, FinOps & Quota Guardrails for Hackathons
